mapper.sql: SELECT 'ACCESS:' || id AS id, id AS record_id, task_name, '同步任务执行记录'::text AS description, 'ACCESS'::text AS source_module, CASE WHEN config_json->>'sourceDatabaseId'=CAST(#{databaseId} AS text) THEN data_count::text END AS output_rows, CASE WHEN config_json->>'targetDatabaseId'=CAST(#{databaseId} AS text) THEN data_count::text END AS input_rows, CASE run_status WHEN 1 THEN 'WAITING' WHEN 2 THEN 'RUNNING' WHEN 3 THEN 'SUCCESS' WHEN 4 THEN 'FAILED' WHEN 6 THEN 'STOPPED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS status, create_time, start_time, end_time, CASE WHEN end_time >= start_time THEN (extract(epoch FROM end_time-start_time)*1000)::bigint END AS duration_ms FROM dh_dataforge_access_task WHERE deleted=0 AND (config_json->>'sourceDatabaseId'=CAST(#{databaseId} AS text) OR config_json->>'targetDatabaseId'=CAST(#{databaseId} AS text)) UNION ALL SELECT 'DEV:' || id AS id, id AS record_id, task_name, 'SQL 执行记录（未统计输入输出量）'::text, 'DEV'::text, NULL::text, NULL::text, CASE WHEN status IN ('WAITING','RUNNING','SUCCESS','FAILED','STOPPED') THEN status WHEN status IN ('SUBMITTING','CANCEL_REQUESTED') THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, create_time, start_time, end_time, duration_ms FROM dh_dataforge_dev_record WHERE deleted=0 AND database_id=#{databaseId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM () l ORDER BY create_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT coalesce(sum(output_rows::numeric) FILTER (WHERE end_time >= #{today}),0)::text AS today_output_rows, coalesce(sum(input_rows::numeric) FILTER (WHERE end_time >= #{today}),0)::text AS today_input_rows, (coalesce(sum(output_rows::numeric),0)+coalesce(sum(input_rows::numeric),0))::text AS total_transfer_rows, (sum(output_rows::numeric) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms>0) * 1000 / nullif(sum(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE output_rows IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms>0),0))::float8 AS read_speed, (sum(input_rows::numeric) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms>0) * 1000 / nullif(sum(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE input_rows IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms>0),0))::float8 AS write_speed FROM () l WHERE status='SUCCESS'

SELECT end_time::date::text AS date, coalesce(sum(output_rows::numeric),0)::text AS output_rows, coalesce(sum(input_rows::numeric),0)::text AS input_rows, (sum(output_rows::numeric) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms>0) * 1000 / nullif(sum(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE output_rows IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms>0),0))::float8 AS read_speed, (sum(input_rows::numeric) FILTER (WHERE duration_ms>0) * 1000 / nullif(sum(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE input_rows IS NOT NULL AND duration_ms>0),0))::float8 AS write_speed FROM () l WHERE status='SUCCESS' AND end_time >= #{since} GROUP BY end_time::date

SELECT collected_time::date::text AS date, avg(response_time_ms)::float8 AS response_time_ms, avg(CASE connection_status WHEN 1 THEN 100.0 WHEN 2 THEN 0.0 END)::float8 AS online_rate FROM dh_dataforge_database_sample WHERE database_id=#{databaseId} AND deleted=0 AND state='COMPLETE' AND collected_time >= #{since} GROUP BY collected_time::date
